sources.note: Main website. Describes PCC as cloud-based healthcare platform for post-acute/long-term care. Lists product categories for SNF, senior living, hospitals, ACOs, health plans, pharmacies, practice groups. Mentions 400+ marketplace integrations.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists certified products: EHR for Practice Groups v3 (2025), CORE EHR, Practitioner Engagement. Mentions ONC HIT certification, CEHRT, EPCS certification, Ohio CEAL designation. Details CPOE, CQM, VDT capabilities.

Full product catalog organized by segment. SNF: EHR, value packages (Advanced Insights, Lab/Imaging, Pharmacy, Nursing Support, Practitioner Engagement), add-ons (Apploi, PDPM Coach, Virtual Health, GL/AP). Senior Living: EHR, Pharmacy Connect, Billing, Senior Sign, Companion, POC, CRM, Document Manager, Nutrition Management, infection control, skin/wound, QuickMAR.

EHR for Practice Groups product page. Describes automated workflows, auto-populated patient data, single login, care coordination via single patient record, data/reporting for value-based care. Targets practice groups serving LTPAC populations.

SNF EHR product page. Cloud-based, ONC-certified. Describes system dashboards, SSO, MPI, clinical documentation (POC, care plans, allergies, weights, vitals), RCM (financial dashboards, billing, claims, trust fund), care transitions, order management. Automated MDS submission to iQIES.

Practitioner Engagement module. Mobile EHR for practitioners — electronic order signing, encounter notes, chart summaries (vitals, notes, labs, medication history), ePrescribing with EPCS, drug interaction alerts, order templates. Secure anywhere/anytime access.

SNF industry solution page. Describes EHR for SNF, Performance Insights (data visualization), Nursing Advantage (assessments and clinical guidance). Clinical documentation, medication management, care transitions, financial operations, staffing/scheduling via Apploi.

Senior Living solution page. Companion mobile app for ADL documentation, Pharmacy Connect, Senior Sign (digital move-in), Billing, CRM, Nutrition Management. Targets independent living, assisted living, memory care.

De-identified data catalog for life sciences. Reveals data breadth: outcomes, biomarkers, diagnoses, co-morbidities, treatments, therapy, encounters, claims, MDS assessments, drug regimens, facility-level order data, HCP/pharmacy relationships. 1.4M+ active patients, 22K+ SNFs, 4K+ ALFs, 10+ years longitudinal data.

Detailed feature guide. Describes core EHR (physician orders, nursing documentation, assessments, care plans, MDS), QuickMAR eMAR with BCMA and pharmacy connectivity, RCM (claims, PDPM, AR, census, budgeting), care coordination (HL7, APIs, FHIR, discharge summaries, readmission alerts), analytics (MDS Analytics, 5-star rating, Market Insights), telehealth, mobile charting, AI-powered predictive analytics.
Attempted to access for reviews and pricing details. Returned 403 — could not access content.
Company financials: $673.2M revenue in 2024, 1,800 customers. Source for financial data.
Audacious Inquiry acquisition (2022) for $650M. Expanded care coordination network for data exchange between providers, care managers, and payers.
Patient Pattern acquisition (2023). Value-based care EHR platform for Medicare Advantage SNPs, PACE programs, ACO REACH.
American HealthTech acquisition (2024). LTC EHR solutions provider, subsidiary of CPSI/TruBridge.
